records.title: Guard: Scalable Straggler Detection and Node Health Management for Large-Scale Training
records.reason: Guard detects slow/failing nodes during large-scale foundation-model pretraining and improves training FLOPs utilization; linked ZeRO lineage is plausible at training systems level but the work does not address inference serving.

records.title: Focused Forcing: Content-Aware Per-Frame KV Selection for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
records.reason: Focused Forcing is training-free per-frame/head KV compression for autoregressive video diffusion, reporting up to 1.48x acceleration and quality gains. It is strongly adjacent to KV-cache eviction, but evidence is video diffusion only and limitations request validation across other architectures/deployments.

records.title: RAP: Resource-Adaptive Planning for Efficient LLM Tool Calling in Edge Computing
records.reason: The abstract describes resource-adaptive edge/cloud routing and claims up to 62% lower latency and 29% lower peak memory for LLM tool calling, linked to FrugalGPT; IEEE DOI primary text could not be retrieved.

records.title: Practical LLM-Based Function-Level Automated Program Repair: How Far Are We?
records.reason: LLM-assisted automated program repair evaluates repair success; no inference-efficiency contribution.
